dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ah, it's a rare treat to have a little time to laze around, and not have to think about all the fighting and killing.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Still, even lazing around isn't much fun on your own.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Do you wanna keep me company for a bit, cutie? I can read you a story if you'd like.
